title: Grok Voice Mode Voices (Ara, Rex, Sal, Eve, Leo) & Tone
description: Compare Grok Voice Mode voices (Ara, Rex, Sal, Eve, Leo), Expressive Mode & custom personas. Exact voice switch paths + Customize Grok tone prompts.
h1: Grok Voice Mode: core voices (Ara, Rex, Sal, Eve, Leo), Expressive Mode, and custom tone.
dek: Filter xAI’s Grok voices by register and accent, understand Expressive Mode vs. custom personas, and copy clean Customize Grok instructions.
lede: Grok’s Voice Mode across iOS, Android, and web pairs expressive real-time speech (with core voices Ara, Rex, Sal, Eve, and Leo plus expanded specialized voices across 25+ languages) with xAI’s persona modes and custom instructions. Here is how to pick the right voice and stop Grok from defaulting to slang or rambling.
answer: Switch Grok's spoken voice inside Voice Mode on iOS, Android, or grok.com using the voice selector: Ara (warm female), Rex (direct male), Sal (smooth conversational male), Eve (upbeat British female), and Leo (authoritative male). To control how Grok actually reasons and talks—not just how it sounds—add behavioral rules under Settings → Customize Grok or inside a custom Grok Bot Description.

  • Expressive Mode: Dynamically adds natural pauses, pacing, emphasis, and conversational inflection based on chat context.
  • Customize Grok (account-wide): Shapes written and spoken structure—use it to strip forced snark, keep spoken replies brief, and separate primary sources from X commentary (full Customize Grok guide).
  • Grok Bot (cloud teammate): Use a standalone Bot’s Edit Profile → Description when you want a persistent specialist persona with hard action boundaries (6 Grok Bot profiles).

## Grok Voice & Clarity Preferences - Answer directly in 2–4 natural spoken sentences first; wait for follow-up before expanding. - Keep tone plain, intelligent, and grounded—no forced slang, sarcasm, or meme banter unless I ask. - When summarizing live X posts or news, separate primary announcements from unverified speculation. - Challenge weak assumptions in my framing clearly and concisely.

faq.q: What are the main Grok Voice Mode voices?
faq.a: The core lineup includes Ara (warm, friendly female), Rex (confident, direct male), Sal (smooth, conversational male), Eve (energetic British female), and Leo (authoritative male), alongside xAI's expanded library of multilingual specialized voices.

faq.q: How do I make Grok Voice Mode less sarcastic or edgy?
faq.a: Open Settings → Customize Grok and add one explicit line: 'Use plain, neutral, matter-of-fact language. Skip jokes, slang, and sarcasm unless I explicitly ask for banter.'

faq.q: What is the difference between Grok Voice personas and Grok Bots?
faq.a: Voice personas change the spoken timbre and conversational style inside Grok Voice Mode. Grok Bots are persistent cloud teammates (built with Cursor) whose job, boundaries, and communication rules live inside Edit Profile → Description.

faq.q: What default personality did Grok 4.6 score on AgentTune's tests?
faq.a: In its September 2026 canonical self-report, Grok 4.6 scored INTJ on MBTI, Type 5 (Investigator) on the Enneagram, pure C on DISC, and 33/50 on Big Five Agreeableness—lower on agreeableness than the Claude and GPT-6 cohorts.
